draw_context: *draw.Context(...), which an app gets from cx.drawing()

types.name: commands.Address
types.doc: Address mode of a sampler along one axis: clamp to the edge texel, or wrap.

types.name: commands.Filter
types.doc: Min and mag filter of a sampler.

types.name: draw.TargetKind
types.doc: How an offscreen target keeps its pixels (section 2b).

tags.name: feedback
tags.doc: Re-rendered every frame it is bound, over its own last frame.

tags.name: backdrop
tags.doc: A backdrop's pack (`draw/backdrop.zig`): the renderer's blur chain writes it.

types.name: draw.TextureFormat
types.doc: Texel formats a draw type can sample.

tags.name: target
tags.doc: An offscreen target in the surface format (section 2b).

types.name: draw.TextureRegion
types.doc: A texel region in a texture, origin at its top-left.

types.name: draw.TextureSampling
types.doc: How a texture is sampled (module guide, section 2a).

types.name: draw.Textures
types.doc: The app's textures: creates and writes queued for the renderer's next stream (section 2).

fields.name: created
fields.doc: Ids below `created` have been recorded into a stream; the rest are pending.

fields.name: kinds
fields.doc: The kind of each `.target` entry; meaningless for the others.

fields.name: backdrop_count
fields.doc: Backdrop ids created so far (`create_backdrop`); not counted in `target_count`.

fields.name: revisions
fields.doc: Moves on every queued write of a texture: the pixel cache folds it into the tiles that sample the texture, because a rewrite changes pixels without changing any record.

types.name: draw.fx.DeviceRect
types.doc: A target's device rect: origin and size in device pixels (section 2).

types.name: draw.wave.Column
types.doc: One view column: the minimum, maximum, and RMS of the samples it covers.

fields.name: rms_color
fields.doc: The RMS band's color, or null for no RMS band (stride 1).

fields.name: lo
fields.doc: The value range mapped to the rect; `hi` at the top.

constants.name: draw.fx.target_edge_max
constants.doc: Longest side of a target, in device pixels.

constants.name: draw.fx.blur_radius_max
constants.doc: Most taps per side of one blur.

functions.name: draw.TextureRing
functions.doc: A ring texture with a write head; `draw.Ring` shows it.

functions.name: draw.Textures.init
functions.doc: An empty table.

functions.name: draw.Textures.create
functions.doc: Reserves the next id for a `width` by `height` texture of `format`, sampled linear and clamped.

functions.name: draw.Textures.create_target
functions.doc: Reserves the next id for an offscreen target of `kind` (module guide, section 2b).

functions.name: draw.Textures.create_backdrop
functions.doc: Reserves the next id for a backdrop's pack (module guide, section 2b).

functions.name: draw.Textures.is_backdrop
functions.doc: True when `id` is a backdrop's pack.

functions.name: draw.Textures.is_target
functions.doc: True when `id` is an offscreen target.

functions.name: draw.Textures.create_sampled
functions.doc: `create` with a sampling mode (module guide, section 2a).

functions.name: draw.Textures.write
functions.doc: Queues `data` for `region` of texture `id`.

functions.name: draw.Textures.write_strided
functions.doc: Queues `data` for `region` of texture `id`, with rows `bytes_per_row` apart.

functions.name: draw.Textures.revision_of
functions.doc: How many writes `id` has had queued, wrapping (see `revisions`).

functions.name: draw.Textures.format_of
functions.doc: The format `id` was created with.

functions.name: draw.Textures.exists
functions.doc: True when `id` names a created (possibly still pending) texture.

functions.name: draw.wave.append
functions.doc: Writes `columns` into the point pool and appends one `Waveform` over `rect`.

functions.name: draw.wave.Pyramid
functions.doc: Min, max, and RMS levels for up to `samples_max` samples (module guide, section 3).

functions.name: draw.wave.Ring
functions.doc: A ring texture view (module guide, section 4).

functions.name: draw.fx.device_rect
functions.doc: The device rect a logical `rect` covers at `scale_120` (section 2).

functions.name: draw.fx.ortho
functions.doc: The projection of a target's pass (section 2): logical pixels to clip space, with the device rect's origin at the top-left.

functions.name: draw.fx.uv_of
functions.doc: The texture coordinates (u0, v0, u1, v1) of logical `rect` in a target that covers `target_rect` (section 2).

functions.name: draw.fx.blur_weight
functions.doc: The normalized weight of tap `i` of a blur of `radius`: the CPU twin of `Blur`'s.

functions.name: draw.fx.composite
functions.doc: Appends a `Composite` of `target`, which covers `target_rect`, over `rect` (section 3).

functions.name: draw.fx.blur
functions.doc: Appends a `Blur` of `target` (covering `target_rect`) over `rect`, along `axis` (0 for horizontal, 1 for vertical), `radius` device texels each side (section 4).
